request.subject: CITY:1

layers.text: Repaint the round tower as pale warm sandstone, a light cream-beige with slightly darker beige shading, and replace the thick black outline by a thin outline in a darker tone of each colour. Keep the terracotta red roofs, the cream plaster cottages with dark timber framing, every shape and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the buildings.
